headline: Patanjali Foods Seeks Retesting After Madhya Pradesh Bans Ghee Batch
summary: Patanjali Foods announced plans to appeal and request retesting after authorities in Madhya Pradesh banned a batch of cow ghee, following a separate product seizure in Maharashtra.
why: Patanjali Foods is a major Indian consumer goods manufacturer. Food safety bans and product seizures present reputation risks and potential revenue impacts for consumer brands.

impacts.name: Patanjali Foods
impacts.why: State food safety bans and enforcement actions damage product demand and brand equity.
